props.name: liked
props.description: Whether the reader has liked it, when controlled.

props.name: count
props.description: The count to show, when controlled. Should already include the reader's own like.

props.name: onLikedChange
props.description: Save the change. The button updates at once; a rejected promise puts it back.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the reason when saving fails and the like is rolled back.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — "Like", "Favourite". Stays the same whether pressed or not.

props.name: countNoun
props.description: What is being counted, for the description — "likes".

props.name: hideCount
props.description: Hide the count and show the heart alone.
